hero.oneLiner: The deck positions Career Point Edutech as a Kota-based, single-segment education business run on an asset-light, debt-free base across test prep (franchisee network plus study material), semi-government/government test-prep projects and university/formal education, with a growing treasury/lending book alongside the core operations.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Management treats the entire business of the Company as a single segment, i.e. the Education Business, so segment reporting is stated as not applicable.
- The outlook section describes "a business that is compounding profitably on an asset-light base", debt-free with a growing cash pile.
- Group structure comprises the listed holding company plus four subsidiaries: Career Point Institute of Skill Development Private Limited and Career Point Learning Solution Limited (wholly owned), and Edutiger Private Limited and Career Point Accessories Private Limited (partly owned).
- Management uses a non-GAAP measure, Return on Operating Capital Employed (RoOCE), specifically "to isolate the return generated by the Company's core education operations from its growing treasury" - operating capital employed excludes loans advanced by the Company and surplus cash, "which together form a significant part of the Company's capital base".

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Balance sheet is stated as debt-free, with debt-to-equity "Nil" in both Q1 FY27 and Q1 FY26, and current ratio at 6.52x versus 5.48x a year earlier.
- Book value per share up 29.4% YoY to Rs 45.92, described as "entirely funded by retained profits".
- The Board recommended to members, for approval, material related party transaction(s) under Regulation 23 of the Listing Regulations read with Section 188 of the Companies Act, and approval of loan, investments, guarantee or security under Section 185 of the Companies Act.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Order book] The Company reports a pipeline of semi-government/government test-prep projects with an order book of approximately Rs 56 crore, scheduled for execution during the current financial year, providing what management calls strong visibility for revenue growth. (The extracted text renders this as "256 crore" in both places it appears; the leading character is the deck's mangled Rs glyph, which the same extract renders as 2/Z/%/7 elsewhere, e.g. "2808.38 lakh" for Rs 808.38 lakh.)
- [Governance] The deck is the outcome of the Board meeting of August 12, 2026; it also covers the 20th AGM scheduled for September 25, 2026, book closure September 19-25, 2026, e-voting with cut-off date September 18, 2026, and Advocate Amit Gupta appointed scrutinizer.
- [Audit] Limited review reports from Rajvanshi & Associates on both standalone and consolidated results carry no qualifications; the consolidated conclusion relies in part on other auditors' reports for the four subsidiaries.
- [Ratio contradiction] The ratio table shows RoOCE falling from 127.64% (Q1 FY26) to 100.56% (Q1 FY27) yet labels the YoY change "+1,150 bps", and shows RoCE falling from 14.9% to 12.8% with the change printed as "210 bps" without a sign; both readings are reproduced as printed rather than reconciled.
